mapper.select: WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT #{YYYYMM} AS YYYYMM , #{USER_ID} AS USER_ID FROM DUAL ) SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.etxpyreqstdmng.mapper.NgtmWorkEtxpyReqstdMngMapper.selectNgtmWorkEtxpyReqstdMngDetail2 : 년간 야간근무수당신청 LIST */ SUBSTR(GIVE_YM, 1, 4)||' 년 '||SUBSTR(GIVE_YM, 5, 2) || '월' AS GIVE_YM , SUBSTR(APRV_YMD, 1, 4) || ' 년 ' || SUBSTR(APRV_YMD, 5, 2) || '월' AS APRV_YM , NIGHT_WORK_HR , PENSN_SUM_AMT , APRV_YN FROM ( SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.etxpyreqstdmng.mapper.NgtmWorkEtxpyReqstdMngMapper.selectNgtmWorkEtxpyReqstdMngDetail2 : 년간 야간근무수당신청 LIST */ AA.GIVE_YM , MAX(AA.APRV_YMD) AS APRV_YMD , SUM(AA.NIGHT_WORK_HR) AS NIGHT_WORK_HR , SUM(AA.PENSN_SUM_AMT) AS PENSN_SUM_AMT , MAX(AA.APRV_YN) AS APRV_YN FROM ZZ , AYC350 AA /* 야간근무수당 */ WHERE 1=1 AND AA.GIVE_YM = ZZ.YYYYMM AND AA.CONSTT_ID = ZZ.USER_ID AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY AA.GIVE_YM ) BB

WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT #{YYYYMM} AS YYYYMM , #{USER_ID} AS USER_ID FROM DUAL ) SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.etxpyreqstdmng.mapper.NgtmWorkEtxpyReqstdMngMapper.selectNgtmWorkEtxpyReqstdMngDetail3 : 년간 야간근무수당신청 count */ 0 AS CNT , MAX(RM_CN) AS BIGO FROM ZZ , AYC350 AA /* 야간근무수당 */ WHERE 1=1 AND AA.GIVE_YM = ZZ.YYYYMM AND AA.CONSTT_ID = ZZ.USER_ID
